ratio.source: the radio doubles the reading to get the cell, so the ratio sets the gauge: 1 % of 4.2 V is 42 mV, a twentieth of the cell's 0.9 V useful range

drain.source: the standby budget: the gauge may take no more than twice the regulator's 1 uA (TPS7A05 SBVS254D, IQ typical) from the cell

vsense.source: the ADC's input stays below its reference, +3V3, with a margin of 1.1 V while the regulator holds it
